Execution.description: The times of statements: log-normal, with a given median and 99th percentile.

median.description: Half of the times are below it. A duration in humantime form, such as `500us` or `2s`.

p99.description: 99 of 100 times are below it, so it is not below the median. A duration in humantime form, such as `500us` or `2s`.

Faults.description: Faults, each with its probability, between 0 and 1.

hang.description: An accepted connection never gets an answer.

refuse.description: An accepted connection is closed at once.

reset.description: A batch ends its connection with a reset.

stall.description: A batch's responses are held back for `stall_for`.

stall_for.description: How long a stalled batch's responses are held back. A duration in humantime form, such as `500us` or `2s`.

statement_timeout.description: A batch whose execution time exceeds it fails with 57014. A duration in humantime form, such as `500us` or `2s`; without it, no batch fails for its time.

Settings.description: Latency and faults, which the admin API can change while connections run.

execution.description: A time drawn for every statement, added to its recorded one.

execution_per_mib.description: Time added to every statement for each MiB of its answer. A duration in humantime form, such as `500us` or `2s`.

execution_scale.description: Factor applied to recorded execution times.

faults.description: What goes wrong, and how often.

round_trip.description: Network round-trip time, added to every batch and every round trip of connection setup. A duration in humantime form, such as `500us` or `2s`.

database.description: The database to connect to, where `{database}` is replaced by the virtual database's name.

password.description: Needed when the upstream asks for a password.

user.description: The user that Pseudogress connects as.

description: A class of virtual databases: a `[[class]]` table of the configuration, or the answer of a class service, which leaves out `recording`.

databases.description: Pattern of database names, where `*` matches any characters. A class service's must match the database that was asked about.

ignore_parameters.description: Statements whose answer doesn't depend on their parameters, by the start of their text: answered by their text alone, and recorded once.

max_connections.description: Connections per database; more get FATAL 53300. Without it, there is no limit.

name.description: Identifies the class. A class from a class service is recorded in `<name>.jsonl`, which restricts its name.

override.description: Replaces a column of recorded rows with generated JSON.

password.description: Password of every user. Without it, passwords are derived from the secret, the database and the user.

upstream.description: The real PostgreSQL that record mode forwards to. A class service must have it, as its classes are for record mode.
